newsitem.title: USA: Sept S&P 500 futures down sharply but off limit.
newsitem.headline: Sept S&P 500 futures down sharply but off limit.

text.p: July 18 - Sept S&P 500 stock index futures bounced off the 15-point downside trading limit but remained down sharply after plunging on weakness in technology shares. Sept S&Ps hit sell stops around 932.00 and 930.00 on the downturn, then encountered a order vacuum down to 925.00, floor traders said. Sept hit a low of 922.95 and was last at 925.25, down 12.70.
